title: Psalm emits this issue when a class defines private final method.
summary: PHP 8.0+ emits a warning when it sees private final method (except __construct where it's allowed), and allows redefinition in child classes (effectively ignoring final modifier). Before PHP 8.0, final was respected in this case. Psalm ignores it at error level 3 and higher.

title: Uninitialized properties are hard to statically analyze.
summary: To prevent mistakes, Psalm will enforce that all properties should be initialized. Psalm ignores it at error level 3 and higher.

title: Psalm emits this issue when setting a property with a value which has a less specific type than the property expects.
summary: Psalm ignores it at error level 4 and higher.
